title: Cohomological Donaldson-Thomas theory of a quiver with potential and quantum enveloping algebras
note: PDF library/arxiv-1601.02479v5/ — held copy is v5 [math.RT], 6 Mar 2020. Cohomological aspects of Donaldson-Thomas theory for Jacobi algebras and the associated cohomological Hall algebra of Kontsevich and Soibelman. Surfaced by the relevance ranking on hopf / crossing / stability / functor overlap; the wall-crossing and integrality material is the part that touches this corpus.
